# Dingwei Battery Technical Documentation

> Official technical documentation for Dingwei Battery — battery specifications, quality control, testing standards, and OEM/private-label guidance.

## Markdown mirrors (for AI crawlers)

Every page is also available as clean Markdown, copied from the documentation sources at build time:

- Full corpus (all pages): [llms-full.txt](https://docs.dingweibattery.com/llms-full.txt)
- Mirror index: [md/index.md](https://docs.dingweibattery.com/md/index.md)
- Pattern: `https://docs.dingweibattery.com/md/<path>.md` — e.g. /md/specs/jis-145g51.md mirrors /specs/jis-145g51/
